name: Swarm by Foursquare
description:
Swarm helps you discover places, check in to where you go, and keep a personal history of your favorite spots. Find restaurants, cafés, parks, museums, bars, and other places nearby or anywhere in the world. Get recommendations based on location, save places to visit later, create and manage lists, and see where you've been over time.

Whether you're planning a trip, exploring a new neighborhood, or trying to remember the great coffee shop you visited last year, Swarm makes it easy to find, organize, and revisit the places that matter to you.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Swarm by Foursquare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Swarm by Foursquare to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.foursquare.com/v2/streaming/mcp/swarm-beta. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Swarm by Foursquare MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swarm by Foursquare lists 49 MCP tools, including activities_recent, add_checkin, add_list_item, add_venue, ask, create_list, delete_list, delete_list_item, flag_venue, follow_list, friends_nearby, and get_checkin.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Swarm by Foursquare?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Swarm by Foursquare in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Swarm by Foursquare MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Swarm by Foursquare requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Swarm by Foursquare is developed by Foursquare Labs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
